notes: Only tests whose command exited successfully are labelled passed. The v3 natural-eviction test explicitly failed its CPU-reload assertion.
Native and v2/v3 single performance samples are exploratory; they are not a statistically qualified release comparison.
The v3 2x200K test proves full input/output reservation under full GPU pressure but predates the hybrid ARC reuse fix. V4 tests that fix with a smaller GPU pool.
Capacity mode warms histories three times. It measures useful retained CPU prefix tokens after GPU reset; it does not guarantee useful capacity for arbitrary cold one-off requests.
CPU and GPU caches are inclusive. Measured capacities cannot be added to guarantee indefinitely alternating independent maximum histories without misses.

A passing two-full test, if present, proves one round of alternation through two independent full histories. A cache miss cancels the probe early and is recorded as a failed test. No indefinite alternation guarantee is inferred.
The v5 full restore caused a global host OOM from native staging. V6 bounds and drains H2D batches at 128 MiB. A 9.18 GB native-DMA probe passes with a fully resident 12 GiB host buffer.
The production image, policy and service configuration have not been promoted to this candidate.
